description: Create a market research survey titled 'Beverage Packaging Concept Test 2025'. The survey must contain a question group named 'Concept Evaluation' with two questions. Question 1 (Code: C1) must display the image 'concept_vibrant.png' (located in ~/Documents/Concepts/) and ask 'How likely would you be to buy this design?' using a 5-Point Choice type. Question 2 (Code: C2) must display 'concept_minimalist.png' (same location) with the same question text and type. You must UPLOAD the images to the survey resources server using the KEditor/Resource Manager within the question editor; do not simply drag-and-drop or link locally. Activate the survey when finished.
